title: One Wheel
lines: Meg had a red tricycle with three wheels.
"I can not ride a bicycle," said Meg.
At the fair, a clown rode a unicycle.
"If he can, so can I," said Meg.
She fell down, got up, and did it again.
Now Meg rides a bicycle every day.

questions.ask: How many wheels did the unicycle have?
questions.listenFor: One. Uni means one - the same one hiding inside unicycle. Tri is three, bi is two.

questions.ask: What happened the first time Meg got on the bicycle?
questions.listenFor: She fell down, then got up and did it again. Line six holds the whole turn.

questions.ask: What is something hard you kept trying? Why did you keep going?
questions.listenFor: Anything from swimming to tying a shoe. The why matters more than the what.
